name: Marquee New York
status_note: Tao Group's official page lists current hours (Wed, Fri, Sat 11pm-4am). Reopened Sept 25, 2025 as 'Marquee 3.0' after a full renovation (Wikipedia, Time Out). The official events calendar showed no listings when fetched; third-party listing shows Marquee Wednesdays in Oct 2026. No public phone; official contact is email only.

dress.detail: Tao's official page publishes no dress code; third-party guides describe smart, elegant attire and say shorts, sportswear, caps and flip-flops get turned away.

cover.value: Ticketed per night; a Marquee Wednesdays listing showed tickets from $82 (Oct 2026); resale averages ~$76

getting_in.value: Buy GA tickets on Tao's events page or book a VIP table on SevenRooms; the door is selective, and a guide warns even ticket holders can be turned away.

subway.value: 23 St (C/E) per one listing; also walkable from 34 St-Hudson Yards (7). Walk time not confirmed.

skip_if: You want a sure thing at the door: guides say the door is selective even with a presale ticket.
You are on a budget: listed GA tickets run around $80 before drinks, and tables are bottle-service bookings.
